none: PAS CAM-F71B31: Roman Coin : Copper-alloy Nummus of Constantine II as Caesar, AD317-337
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ GLORIA EXERCITVS ; D/ CONSTANTINVS IVN N C

A copper-alloy nummus of Constantine II as Caesar, AD317-337. AD335-337 (Reece period 17). Reverse legend reads GLORIA EXERCITVS. Reverse shows Two soldiers and one standard. Mint is unclear. Obverse legend reads CONSTANTINVS IVN N C. Obverse shows Laureate and cuirassed bust right. Reverse fields and exergue reads: - //... Die axis is 12 o'clock. Weight is 1.0g, diameter is 14.3mm
